name: zabify
description: Zabify — open-source YouTube Music streaming client

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared --if-present && npm run test -w apps/api --if-present && npm run test -w apps/web --if-present
